command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /opt/inventory-api
cat > /opt/inventory-api/server.py <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

DATA = Path('/var/lib/inventory-api/inventory.json')

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/health':
            body = b'{"status":"ok"}\n'
            status = 200
        elif self.path == '/inventory':
            body = DATA.read_bytes()
            status = 200
        else:
            body = b'{"error":"not found"}\n'
            status = 404
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
PY_EOF
chmod 0755 /opt/inventory-api/server.py
install -d -m 0755 /var/lib/inventory-api

{"items":[{"sku":"widget-001","quantity":42},{"sku":"gadget-002","quantity":7}]}
JSON_EOF

OOMScoreAdjust=-1000

ManagedOOMPreference=avoid
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadOnlyPaths=/var/lib/inventory-api

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
